story.title: Story 4: Derivation State, Report, and Repair

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on SV-04-001, ruling 012, directly touched turn/chunk read surfaces, TC-4.7 coverage, sanctioned Epic 01 assertion amendments, and configured gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Ruling 012 explicitly rejected the prior deviation and required direct form-state attachment on turn and chunk reads. Production code now adds TurnRecord.forms via listTurns/readOwnedForms and adds ChunkRecord plus turns.listChunks with summary-form states attached. TC-4.7 now asserts message, turn, and chunk read state attachment directly, including blocked turn forms and failed chunk summary reason. Story deviation rows record ruling 012 and the sanctioned Epic 01 exact-shape amendments.

verified: Sanctioned Epic 01 assertion amendments recorded in story deviation table
Production path audit: turn/chunk reads use real SQLite-backed domain reads and stored derived_form rows; no fake runtime adapter or shim found

additionalObservations: Focused TC-4.7 now has 10 report-repair tests passing; green-verify passes with 186 tests and immutability OK; verify-all passes with 208 tests.

Tech-design Interfaces still need a later wording cleanup for TurnRecord.forms, ChunkRecord, and turns.listChunks, but ruling 012 and the story deviation table establish the accepted story scope for this handoff.
